milestones.title: Controlled adaptive reasoning
milestones.scenario: Pre-register E1/E2 and persona-only comparisons; execute no more than the authorized five calls; compare material decisions with fixed objective/state/config; preserve failures.
milestones.proof: Frozen bytes, prompts, input invariants, provider attempt receipts, outputs, policy and independent material-divergence review. A single batch is a bounded demonstration, not a statistical proof of general causal behavior.

milestones.title: Evidence and final-candidate review
milestones.scenario: Capture real current evidence, identify material claims, assess support, render, then review the exact final candidate. Use a genuinely invoked reviewer where required.
milestones.proof: Source spans/hashes, claim coverage, final content hash, platform checks, cultural review event when applicable. No caller-declared support or URL-only pass.

milestones.title: Three complete unpublished dry runs
milestones.scenario: Run social-a, social-b, social-c through the production loop with new current evidence, adaptive decision, draft, reviews, planned experiment, research learning, and next schedule.
milestones.proof: One manifest per bot; independent final-candidate review; zero publication; no fabricated audience baseline/outcome; all required stages actually exercised.

milestones.title: Scheduled operation and real lead/worker loop
milestones.scenario: Observe at least three genuine scheduler firings across at least two scheduled intervals; one bounded task each. Add contention, killed lease-holder recovery, and two changed lead assignments.
milestones.proof: Native scheduler/job history, invocation and heartbeat receipts, exact consumed direction SHA, actual code/artifact outputs, no owner task copying. No periodic heartbeat soak. The lead write route must really exist.

milestones.title: Verified social account routes
milestones.scenario: Verify each required platform/account/persona/destination/readback/analytics route using supported current capabilities.
milestones.proof: Account metadata and verification time, credential alias only, route capabilities, exact owner gates. Unsupported is not connected; scope reduction requires a lead/owner decision.

milestones.title: Bounded public canaries
milestones.scenario: One explicitly authorized canary for each general persona, external readback, genuine observation window, measured update and next decision.
milestones.proof: Intent/attempt/readback/permalink, uncertainty reconciliation, raw metric semantics, next decision. Do not repeat a post just to make a test pass.

milestones.title: Continuous three-bot operation
milestones.scenario: Use a predeclared 24-hour acceptance window as the proposed default; all three bots have at least two due-cycle opportunities and a real measurement-to-next-decision chain.
milestones.proof: Complete invocation coverage, no unauthorized/duplicate effect, justified no-action outcomes, recovery, owner-gate traces and standalone/no-SwarmAI proof. Window is a test design, not a delivery-time estimate.

milestones.title: Fault recovery
milestones.scenario: Inject process termination, stale leases, provider/network outage, and disk/receipt failures on isolated test state; observe recovery without external duplicate attempts.
milestones.proof: Fault timeline and receipts, exactly identified tested scope, independent re-execution, no supported-path unresolved critical defect.

milestones.title: Platform selection in operation
milestones.scenario: Feed real route availability and current evidence to the actual selector; show justified choice or no-platform, not blind cross-posting.
milestones.proof: Selector input/output linked to the actual draft route; no authority gain from choosing a platform.

milestones.title: Analytics semantics
milestones.scenario: Ingest real observations through the normalized adapter and reject incompatible windows/kinds/denominators.
milestones.proof: Raw-to-normalized trace, provider fields, missing-vs-zero handling, dedup and schema version.

milestones.title: Audience memory
milestones.scenario: Use permitted real aggregate data to update a hypothesis, retain contradictory evidence, and retrieve it under persona scope.
milestones.proof: Evidence-linked confidence/freshness update and actual retrieval in a later decision; no sensitive individual profiling.

milestones.title: Experiment closeout
milestones.scenario: Close a real observation window with compatible baseline/treatment and return success, failure, stopped, or inconclusive truthfully.
milestones.proof: No missing-to-zero coercion, no cross-persona baseline, no outcome before a verified intervention/window.

milestones.title: Rendered content and lineage
milestones.scenario: Produce a real-source candidate and platform-specific variant through production formatting, preserving factual lineage and detecting repetition.
milestones.proof: Final candidate/readable preview, claims and citations, lineage records, reviewer receipts; no publication needed to validate drafting.

milestones.title: Community operation
milestones.scenario: Observe permitted real community/thread data, update scoped conversation memory, and produce a correctly bound reply decision/draft or ignore.
milestones.proof: Exact account/thread identity, permission checks, privacy handling and content review. Actual replies require G-PUBLISH; read-only acceptance cannot imply replies were sent.

milestones.title: Both cultural personas
milestones.scenario: Run both cultural personas with real attributed sources, actual required reviewer events, uncertainty and correction paths, and distinct non-disguised editorial identity.
milestones.proof: Exact reviewed candidate/evidence hashes and reviewer method; no claim of human endorsement when review was automated.

milestones.title: Stable unattended release
milestones.scenario: Proposed default: 72-hour unattended window, local backup/restore test, budget exhaustion, account/provider degradation and recovery. Reuse compatible earlier-window evidence.
milestones.proof: Full scheduled/attempted/completed denominator, no unauthorized or duplicated external effects, zero untriaged critical defects, safe stop and restore. Do not hide skipped firings or outages.

milestones.title: Measured strategy change
milestones.scenario: Actual permitted evidence produces bounded revision/hold/rollback through production policy and storage, then a later run consumes that version.
milestones.proof: Two distinct strategy versions or justified HOLD, evidence bindings, CAS/fence trace, H1/H2 execution. A forced strategy change is not proof when data does not support one.

milestones.title: Strategy lifecycle
milestones.scenario: Use live history plus labeled fault cases to exercise active/cooling/expired/rollback behavior; expired data cannot silently remain authoritative.
milestones.proof: Version history, real timestamp provenance, actual runtime selection of the permitted state; synthetic time labeled.

milestones.title: Executed bounded plan
milestones.scenario: A real bot goal produces a bounded DAG, executes safe tasks through the scheduler, encounters a real or explicitly injected blocker, and replans without losing done work.
milestones.proof: H3 task claim/output traces, stable completed task hashes, resource caps, no model-generated shell/code executed as untrusted instructions.

milestones.title: Integrated specialists and parent reasoning
milestones.scenario: After predecessor acceptance, a production parent dispatches at least researcher and reviewer/analyst tasks, enforces scope/budgets/deadlines, adopts valid outputs, and rejects a clearly labeled bad-result probe.
milestones.proof: H1–H4 and ordinary entrypoint evidence, bounded real provider calls where claimed, supervised child lifecycle, rejection leaves protected parent state unchanged, accepted output influences a later decision.

milestones.title: Institutional memory
milestones.scenario: Ingest available real experiment/incident history, retrieve it in later reasoning, preserve contradictions and test seasonality with explicitly time-shifted fixtures.
milestones.proof: Live-history coverage dates, real retrieval trace, separate time-shift tests. Do not claim months of operating history if only days exist.

milestones.title: Aggregate audience segments
milestones.scenario: Use permitted aggregate features with a predeclared support threshold; produce stable useful segments only if supported.
milestones.proof: Feature provenance, sample/window, privacy filter and actual strategy differentiation. Insufficient data remains a gate; do not invent segments.

milestones.title: Current trend decisions
milestones.scenario: Use genuine time-separated trend captures, dedup shared origins, select persona-relevant opportunity and reject irrelevant virality.
milestones.proof: Raw timestamps, temporal sample coverage, relevance/novelty reason, actual planned action or no-action. One snapshot cannot prove velocity.

milestones.title: Cross-platform strategy
milestones.scenario: One canonical idea produces distinct supported platform drafts, sequencing and attribution under real route constraints.
milestones.proof: Same idea ID, claim-lineage preservation, scheduler queue and duplication controls. Publication/readback evidence only if independently authorized.

milestones.title: Resource allocation used by scheduling
milestones.scenario: Allocate real finite worker/model/time capacity across eligible opportunities and show the scheduler obeys reservations and protected reliability/exploration capacity.
milestones.proof: Allocation decision, reservations, actual usage/refusal, no overspend or unauthorized route fallback; estimates remain estimates.

milestones.title: Self-evaluation without self-approval
milestones.scenario: Use real operational history plus labeled seeded regressions to detect drift/repetition/reliability issues and submit a bounded improvement artifact.
milestones.proof: Evidence-supported diagnosis, test/rollback proposal, independently checked denial of self-approval/deployment.

milestones.title: Concurrent multi-brand operation
milestones.scenario: Run two owner-approved brand scopes with multiple personas through the ordinary production path, shared-safe knowledge, specialists, portfolio scheduling and organizational learning.
milestones.proof: Per-brand isolation/readback/decision traces, rejected private cross-brand read, shared fact lineage, resource accounting, restore/recovery and bounded improvement workflow. Public effects require their own grant.
